checklist_title: A little preparation goes a long way.
checklist_description: Your personal pre-walk checklist. Adapt your kit to the route, weather and your needs.
checklist_safety: A completed checklist cannot guarantee safety. Check current conditions, access and your own ability.
empty_checklist: Your checklist is empty. Add items or restore the defaults.
restore_defaults_warning: Replace your current checklist with the defaults? Custom items and checked states will be removed.
journal_description: A private space for the places you’ve been and the moments worth keeping.
journal_empty_body: Add a completed walk to start your personal journal.
no_favourites: Mark a walk as a favourite to find it here.
delete_walk_body: “%1$s” and its private photo copies will be permanently removed from this device.
personal_rating: Personal rating · Select again to clear
remove_photo_body: Remove this app-private copy? Your original photo will remain unchanged.
photo_privacy: Up to eight photos per walk. Copies stay private on this device; location metadata is removed.
duration_estimate_hint: The initial estimate uses 4 km/h. Adjust it for your pace, stops and terrain.
share_plan_privacy: Only this static plan is shared when you open the sharing options. There is no live tracking or emergency monitoring.
build_notice: TrailNest %1$s · Development build · Not approved for Appstore release
recording_notification: Open TrailNest to resume, finish or discard.
recording_description: Records while the screen is off or the app is minimised, with a persistent notification. Keep location enabled. Battery controls and device GPS availability can interrupt recording. Distance is an estimate; this is not a safety tracker.
recording_privacy: Only duration and estimated distance are stored privately on this device. Coordinates are used in memory and discarded. Nothing is uploaded.
recording_interrupted: Recording was interrupted. The last checkpoint is paused; resume explicitly. Time and distance since that checkpoint may be missing.
recording_notifications: Allow notifications when asked to see recording controls outside the app. If notifications are disabled, reopen My walks to pause or finish.
recording_waiting: Waiting for a recent location accurate to 40 m or better. Time continues; distance may be incomplete.
recording_save_hint: Journal duration is rounded up to at least one whole minute. Zero distance means no reliable movement was measured; you can correct it later.
recording_permission: Allow location to record a walk. Approximate location may be too imprecise to measure distance.
recording_location_disabled: Enable location in device settings. This device needs an available location provider to record.
recording_start_failed: Recording could not start. Check location permissions and device settings; any existing draft is paused.
recording_title_required: Enter a walk title before saving.
headline: A little further.\nA little freer.
tagline: Discover more. Walk confidently. Explore your way.
no_routes: Good walks start with good information.
coverage_message: Our UK route collection is being prepared. Only reviewed routes will appear here.
